spans.s:
(उ,) घणु r. 8th cl. (घणुति or घणुते)
To shine.

m. (-ण्टः)
A sort of sauce, vegetables made into a pulp with water, turmeric, mustard seeds and capsicums.
f. (-ण्टा)
1 A bell; also a plate of iron or mixed metal struck as a bell.
2 A plant: see घण्टापाटली.
E.
हन to strike, ट affix, fem. टाप्, and deriv. irr.

m. (-कः)
A plant: see घण्टापाटली.
E.
कन् added to the preceding; some copies read घण्टीक and घाण्टीक.

m. (-र्णः)
One of ŚIVA'S attendants, who is supposed to preside over cutaneous complaints, and is worshipped for exemption from them in the month Chaitra.
E.
घण्टा, and कर्ण an ear; having ears as broad as a bell.

m. (-डः)
A bellman, one who strikes a bell or Gharī.
E.
घण्टा, and ताड who beats.

n. (-नं)
Striking a bell.
E.
घण्टा, and ताडन beating.

m. (-दः)
The sound of a bell, &c.
E.
घण्टा, and माद sound.

m. (-थः)
The chief road through a village, a highway.
E.
घण्टा a bell, and पथि a road, affix अ; the bell-road, or that by which elephants, &c. decorated with tinkling ornaments^1, proceed.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

f. (-ली)
A plant commonly called by the similar name Ghaṇṭāpārali, a species of the trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.)
E.
घण्टा a bell, &c. and पाटली the trumpet flower.

n. (-द्यं)
The sound of a clock.
E.
घण्ठा, and वाद्य playing.

n. (-जं)
The croton nut.
E.
घण्टा, and वीज seed.

f. (-वा)
Crotolaria of various species.
E.
घण्टा, and रव sound; the seed rattling within the husk.

Bellmetal.
2

The sound of a bell.
E.
घण्टा, and शब्द sound.

m. (-नः)
The sound of a bell or clock.
E.
घण्टा, and स्वन sound.

f. (-का)
The uvula or soft palate.
E.
घण्ठा a bell, and कन् affix of similitude.

m. (-कः)
1 A bard, who sings in chorus, but especially in honour of the gods, and rings a bell in presence of their images.
2 Datura fastuosa.
E.
घण्टा a bell, affix ठक्.

m. (-ण्टुः)
1 A string of bells tied on an elephant's chest, &c. by way of ornament.
2 Heat, light, &c. घण to shine, Uṇādi affix टु.

m. (-रः)
A minor deity, the son of MARS.
E.
घण्टा, and ईश्रर lord.

m. (-ण्डः)
A bee.
